personalInfo.name: Mohammad Aghaei
personalInfo.title: Full-Stack Engineer
personalInfo.bio: I build production-ready web applications across the frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers.
personalInfo.aboutMeIntro: I am a Full-Stack Engineer focused on building modern web applications with TypeScript and the JavaScript ecosystem.
aboutMeDetailed: I work across the frontend and backend, with experience building dashboards, SaaS applications, REST APIs, multi-tenant systems, authentication and authorization systems, data-driven interfaces, and production infrastructure.
My main frontend technologies are React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. On the backend I work with Node.js, NestJS, Prisma, Drizzle and PostgreSQL.
I also work with Docker, Linux and CI/CD, allowing me to work across the complete lifecycle of a web application.
personalInfo.projectsPageIntro: Selected projects across frontend, backend, and full-stack development — from SaaS platforms to developer tools.
personalInfo.sideProjectsPageIntro: Additional web applications and tools built alongside client work and personal experiments.
personalInfo.servicesPageIntro: Full-stack development services — from custom web applications and admin panels to backend APIs, SaaS platforms, and improving existing projects.
personalInfo.hireMePageSubtitle: Let's talk about your idea and build something useful together.

highlights: Working independently on full-stack web applications, including frontend development, backend/API development, database design, and deployment.
Architected and developed a management dashboard using NestJS and Prisma with RBAC and tenant data isolation in a multi-tenant architecture.
Optimized client-server synchronization with TanStack Query and Axios, eliminating approximately 40% of redundant network requests and improving perceived loading time by 35%.
Created onboarding documentation, performed code reviews, and mentored junior developers, reducing average onboarding time by approximately 25%.
Developed WelloWize, a cognitive assessment platform and multi-tenant SaaS dashboards using React.
Contributed to and guided development from technical design through implementation and code review.
Designed backend integration strategies for adaptive and AI-generated data flows.
Built data-driven analytical dashboards with ECharts and Tailwind CSS for displaying more than 10,000 daily cognitive data points with latency below 150ms.
Developed B2B management dashboards with React, TypeScript and Vite in a Monorepo architecture.
Implemented role-based access control and application state management with Zustand.
Containerized frontend applications with Docker to eliminate configuration differences between environments.

project-endpoint-forge.name: Endpoint Forge
project-endpoint-forge.description: A UI-managed mock API workbench for building and running realistic backend endpoints before production APIs are ready.
project-endpoint-forge.tagline: Model API contracts visually and start a mock server your frontend can call immediately.
project-endpoint-forge.overview: Endpoint Forge helps teams unblock frontend development when backend contracts are incomplete or still changing. It provides a UI for creating projects, organizing routes, defining responses, and running a mock server that frontend applications can integrate with right away.

problemStatement.title: Frontend blocked on backend availability
problemStatement.description: Teams often depend on unfinished APIs, scattered JSON fixtures, or ad hoc mock servers that are hard to share and maintain across a project.

project-wellowize.name: WelloWize
project-wellowize.description: A cognitive assessment platform with multi-tenant SaaS dashboards for analyzing large volumes of assessment data.
project-wellowize.tagline: Data-driven dashboards for cognitive assessment workflows at scale.
project-wellowize.overview: WelloWize is a cognitive assessment product built with React, combining multi-tenant SaaS dashboards with analytical views powered by ECharts. I contributed across technical design, frontend implementation, backend integration, and code review.

problemStatement.title: Visualizing high-volume cognitive data
problemStatement.description: The platform needed responsive dashboards capable of presenting large daily datasets with low latency while supporting adaptive and AI-generated data flows.

project-physitoo.name: Physitoo
project-physitoo.description: A home healthcare platform focused on connecting patients with physiotherapy and rehabilitation services.
project-physitoo.tagline: Digital workflows for home healthcare and physiotherapy services.
project-physitoo.overview: Physitoo is a healthcare platform for home physiotherapy services. The work involved building structured user-facing flows and integrating with backend services to support service management and patient-facing experiences.

problemStatement.title: Digitizing home healthcare coordination
problemStatement.description: The product needed reliable web interfaces to support service discovery, coordination, and operational workflows for home healthcare providers.

custom-web-app.title: Custom Web Application Development
custom-web-app.description: Turn business ideas and workflows into a dedicated web application.
highlights: When your business needs more than a simple website, I can build the frontend, backend, API, and database as one integrated product.

admin-panel.title: Admin Panel Design & Development
admin-panel.description: Build professional admin panels for managing users, data, and business workflows.
highlights: Data-driven panels with tables, filters, charts, forms, roles, and access levels — with a strong focus on performance and user experience.

backend-api.title: Backend & API Development
backend-api.description: Design and implement backend services and APIs for your website or application.
highlights: Backend structure, database design, REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and core business logic with a scalable architecture.

saas-multi-tenant.title: SaaS & Multi-Tenant Systems
saas-multi-tenant.description: Build SaaS products with multi-tenant architecture and access control.
highlights: For products used by multiple companies, teams, or customers on one platform, I design systems with data isolation, roles, and permission layers.

existing-projects.title: Existing Project Development & Improvement
existing-projects.description: Bug fixes, new features, and improvements for existing projects.
highlights: If you already have a project, I can help add features, refactor code, fix frontend or backend issues, and improve performance.

deployment-infrastructure.title: Project Deployment & Infrastructure
deployment-infrastructure.description: Prepare and deploy your project for production environments.
highlights: Project setup with Docker, Linux and Nginx configuration, environment management, and CI/CD pipelines for reliable deployments.

side-schematic-form-builder.name: Schematic Form Builder
side-schematic-form-builder.description: A schematic form builder for defining and previewing dynamic form layouts in the browser.
side-schematic-form-builder.tagline: Design form structures visually before wiring them into an app.
side-schematic-form-builder.overview: An interactive form builder that lets developers define fields, layout, and structure for dynamic forms with a live preview.

side-jobgraph.name: JobGraph
side-jobgraph.description: A full-stack job tracking application with separate frontend and backend repositories.
side-jobgraph.tagline: Track job applications with a dedicated frontend and API backend.
side-jobgraph.overview: JobGraph includes a React frontend and a dedicated backend service for managing job search data, application status, and related workflows.

side-germany-train-stations.name: Germany Train Stations
side-germany-train-stations.description: An interactive map application for exploring Germany train station data.
side-germany-train-stations.tagline: Map-based exploration of train station datasets.
side-germany-train-stations.overview: A frontend application built to visualize and explore Germany train station data with map-based interaction and filtering.
